People Ops: @here Quick summer update — new quickguide for time-off + travel declarations. Please read when you get a sec. TL;DR: if you're traveling internationally while on PTO (personal or work-related) between May 1–Aug 31, submit the one-click travel declaration and safety check-in so we can support you and comply with regional rules. Also launching a small PTO top-up pilot for caregiving during extended travel (opt-in). Full doc: https://redwood.internal/hr/summer-travel-timeoff-guide :wave:

Maya: Quick Q — is this required for domestic trips too?

People Ops: Not required for routine domestic travel unless your manager asks or you're going to a high-risk area. Recommended for cross-border trips or if you'll be in area with travel advisories. The form is short (<2 mins).

Sam (Legal): Added context — avoid travel to countries on our sanctions/POI list. If someone's itinerary intersects with restricted jurisdictions, reach out to legal before booking. legal@redwood.com

Jon (Travel Ops): FYI: bookings made through Concur will auto-attach to the declaration if you opt in. Personal bookings need the link. If you hit issues on mobile, DM me.

Nate: Can someone paste a tiny checklist? I skimmed and missed the action items.

People Ops: Sure — copy/paste of the short checklist:```
- Submit travel declaration form (link in the doc)
- Confirm emergency contact + local embassy info in your profile
- Opt into safety check-in (optional)
- If caregiving during travel, apply for PTO top-up (pilot) with manager sign-off
- Notify People Ops for unusual/risky itineraries
```

Ava: Will the PTO top-up change my balance or payroll?

People Ops: No payroll changes. The pilot grants a one-time 8-hour PTO credit (if approved) that appears as a manual adjustment after manager and People Ops sign-off. It's opt-in and only for caregiving while traveling; not for normal vacation. Pilot runs through Oct 31, after which we'll evaluate and share results.

Maya: Who approves the top-up? Manager + People Ops?

People Ops: Correct — manager confirms caregiving need, People Ops verifies and applies the credit. For edge cases Legal may be looped in.

Jon (Travel Ops): reporting a small issue — form sometimes fails to save recent changes on Android Chrome. Filed ticket #5467 with eng-support. If it hits you, try desktop or Safari for now.

Ava: :thumbsup: thanks for the heads up.

People Ops: Thanks all. Reminder: this is about safety and support, not surveillance — declarations are used to offer help and maintain compliance only. If you have concerns about privacy, DM People Ops. Full guide + form: https://redwood.internal/hr/summer-travel-timeoff-guide — please submit before finalizing bookings if possible.
